source_row.rationale: Cardiac rehabilitation referral for heart failure clients is important because participation is associated with improved functional capacity, quality of life, and potentially reduced hospitalization and mortality, extending benefits recognized in cardiac rehabilitation beyond post-myocardial infarction populations alone.
